entities.name: Adenine deaminase
observations: The 332-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q1QDL4 adenine deaminase from Psychrobacter cryohalolentis.
Strong homologs include reviewed adenine deaminases Q6FCU0 and Q7M9R5 with 62.7% and 57.2% identity, respectively, over about 98% coverage.
The sequence contains the A_deaminase domain PF00962 spanning residues 9–329; an AMP_deaminase-related domain hit PF19326 occurs at residues 188–325.
Curated annotations assign EC 3.5.4.2, zinc binding, cytosolic localization, adenine catabolism, and hypoxanthine salvage.

entities.name: Adenine deamination
observations: Rhea RHEA:23688: adenine + H2O + H(+) = hypoxanthine + NH4(+).
This is a hydrolytic deamination in which the adenine exocyclic amino group is replaced by oxygen, yielding hypoxanthine and ammonium.

entities.name: Zinc cofactor
observations: Reviewed adenine deaminase annotations state that each subunit binds one Zn2+ ion.
GO annotation includes zinc ion binding (GO:0008270).

entities.name: Purine salvage
observations: The enzyme is annotated in adenine catabolism and hypoxanthine salvage.
GO terms include adenine catabolic process (GO:0006146) and hypoxanthine salvage (GO:0043103).
